articles.title: Jackson Chourio’s two-run walk-off single off of Mason Miller lifts Brewers to NLDS Game 2 victory
articles.description: Chourio's single came with his team down to its final out off of Miller, who tied for the National League lead with 38 saves this season.

articles.title: Brewers edge Padres in NLDS opener that features a ball off the roof in the ninth inning
articles.description: Ty France hit the roof of American Family Field and the ball landed in the glove of Brewers left fielder Jackson Choirio for the second out of the ninth inning.

articles.title: Tarik Skubal dominates in 100-degree heat as the Dodgers beat the Braves in NLDS opener
articles.description: The two-time Cy Young Award winner allowed one run and two hits, struck out seven and walked two while starting a postseason game at home for the first time in his career.

articles.title: The Red Sox went their separate ways. With a lockout looming, nobody knows when they will reunite.
articles.description: A possible lockout in 2027 adds to the uncertainty.

articles.title: White Sox beat Guardians in Game 1 of ALDS behind Munetaka Murakami homer
articles.description: It was the sixth White Sox postseason shutout, their first since the finale of a 2005 World Series sweep of Houston.

articles.title: Why not give rooting for the White Sox, a team loaded with Red Sox and other local connections, a try?
articles.description: In addition to 2018 world champion Andrew Benintendi, the White Sox boast ex-Red Sox prospects Chase Meidroth, Braden Montgomery, and Kyle Teel. And there are other local tie-ins.

articles.title: Despite another early exit, Sam Kennedy says Red Sox believe in promise of Craig Breslow
articles.description: In speaking with the Globe before the playoffs began, the Sox CEO discussed long-term continuity at the top baseball job.

articles.title: In the end the Red Sox were who we thought they were, and other thoughts
articles.description: The Red Sox have won exactly one playoff series in the last eight seasons.

articles.title: Braves hit three homers to beat Phillies in wild card clincher
articles.description: The Braves won a postseason series for the first time since winning the 2021 World Series.

articles.title: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo returning for 11th season with franchise
articles.description: The manager signed a two-year deal that keeps him under contract in the desert through the 2028 season.

articles.title: MLB won’t consider game at Grand Teton National Park, says was only conducting initial due diligence
articles.description: The baseball commissioner said MLB was doing its "due diligence on many potential sites" but that the national park will no longer be under consideration.

articles.title: Following loss, Willson Contreras critical of Red Sox’ reliance on data and analytics
articles.description: Boston's best hitter in 2026 suggested both specific areas in which the Sox needed to improve, but also macro-level adjustments.

articles.title: Late-season malaise, lack of power hitting doom the Red Sox in the end
articles.description: After fighting their way into contention, the Red Sox lost that fight, going 14-16 over the remaining 30 regular-season games heading into the playoffs.

articles.title: ‘I’m hoping they can put it back to normal’: Caleb Durbin, Mickey Gasper, Willson Contreras among Red Sox needing to heal
articles.description: Among the reasons Durbin played through his injury: He wasn’t alone.

articles.title: Sonny Gray says there’s ‘a lot of baseball left in me,’ but is undecided about what’s next
articles.description: The righthander had a solid season for the Red Sox, but was unhappy with being lifted in the fifth inning of Game 2 on Wednesday.

articles.title: Problems were myriad, but early hooks by new manager Chad Tracy were among major Red Sox missteps
articles.description: Tracy — such a feel-good story across this comeback season — turned into a pumpkin just in time for the calendar to flip to October.
